limitations: EOM never fills a normalized milestone: the vendor states support programs continue after End of Maintenance, so it is kept as the vendor's own cell only.
The firmware release cycle (CTX241500, 7-year 3+3+1) is a policy, never a date; stored milestones are the vendor's own stated days.
The current matrix lists products not yet at end of life by its own design; retired firmware lines live on the legacy matrix page, which this source reads beside the current one.
MPX/SDX platform rows carry appliance lifecycle dates and are reported as excluded rows here; they are a hardware scope, not this firmware record.
The pages' 'Last updated' stamps can lag the tables; a refresh republishes whatever the tables state.
